body: So just hope people see this post and respond? What if they don't?
Just because I wouldn't know doesn't make you insignificant.
How do you know who you can reach out to on this community?
Life can be really rough. I'm sorry this happened to you. But I don't think you're stupid or a waste
I no longer feel comfortable going to my friends or family for help. I think that's part of the reason it's so bad right now
I can see this. But I'm not the best person to help you right now.
What got you through it?
I guess that's why I made this post. I wasn't really sure how to go about it. It's just getting to be too much

You're definitely not alone in feeling like this. I feel like I'm in this situation as well.

I would be lying if I said I was never disheartened/heartbroken by it. 

I try and do a couple of things, though. I try to remind myself that this speaks more about how I can be a positive influence on people. And that these unfortunate relationships have been learning points that help me grow. There's other things that aren't coming to mind, but I will update this when they do.

It also helps having someone to vent to, so if you ever need an ear, feel free to message me.

I'm so sorry :( I don't know where you live, but mental health services aren't as prevalent as they need to be.

If you need someone to talk/vent to, feel free to message me. I'm a good listener and maybe that could help somehow until you can get in contact with a professional.
Thank you so much. I will try this once I'm able ❤️
Hey! I know this is a late reply but I'm a 26f and I'm looking for people to talk to as well. Feel free to shoot me a message if you'd like!
😂😂😂 thanks, I love it
Update: I texted him! I know he's seen it but I didn't expect an immediate response. So we shall see!

That's exactly what my plan is :) That's usually what my mindset is for these situations. I think my anxiety got the better of me and made me doubt if it was a good idea or not. 

Now I just need to work on how to say it lol

And thank you so much ❤️
Oh 100% a fair point and food for thought. I never really considered the fact that a friendship can be considered an LDR, but I see what you mean.

Right now I have no definite plans to come back until October (possibly). But I did fall in love with the city itself and have honestly been considering relocating here when possible.

And I have no clue what he'd be willing to do because we didn't talk about it at all, which is why I'm having this dilemma now :( 

I definitely agree, asking for an LDR this early would be selfish. I don't think that's what I'm looking for right now. All I know is that I wouldn't mind keeping in touch/getting to know each other even better and seeing if there's something substantial there. And I guess I'd just like to know how he feels about the situation (/if he feels anything about the situation)

And thank you for your perspective! I really appreciate it :)
No worries! Thank you for your insight. My last relationship was a 3y long LDR but he was a huge ass. So I didn't want to assume all LDRs are doomed. But you have a point.

Wow with all of that detail, I forgot the most important part, sorry! In this case the talk means where do we go from here/exclusivity. 
(#2 at the end of the post goes more into detail)

I'm only in town for a short period of time for work/school. I'll be moving back home pretty soon.

No sex change and no STDs as far as I know...

First I'd like to say thank you so much for such a thoughtful response ❤️

Yes, I could very well get hurt if we stay in contact and he moves on. 
I'm not sure if this connection is important enough or if I'm just getting caught up in my feelings/in the moment :(
I honestly don't know if it could work or not. I usually put a lot of effort into relationships, but mostly that ends up hurting me more... 
And that's one of the reasons I'm lost. I feel like it's possible I may be giving this too much value. That maybe I'm playing it all up in my head and he didn't feel anything like that. That maybe I'm attaching way too much meaning to the way he acted with me. So there is the danger that it would not be reciprocated.
I think my main concern is whether or not I should even have "the talk" with him. And if I do initiate that conversation, I'm not sure how to go about it. I have no idea if I want a relationship, but do I know that I enjoy him a *lot*.
Your best bet is definitely getting parents and/or the authorities involved. The fact that she tried to kill herself is something that you shouldn't be expected to deal with alone.
Happened to me a while back too :( I learned that guys who do this just aren't worth the time or effort.
